storyTitle: Westminster Council Stands Against Far-Right Extremism

watchability.hook: Unanimous Westminster Council vote launching a new Community Equality Strategy and cross-community taskforce
watchability.localRelevance: Affects Westminster residents across 180+ nationalities and 150+ languages, partnering faith leaders, youth voices, and police

claims.statement: Westminster City Council unanimously passed a motion on Wednesday, 12 November 2025 condemning racism, discrimination, and far-right extremism.
claims.sourceQuote: The council unanimously passed a motion at its meeting on Wednesday, 12 November 2025, condemning all forms of hate and pledging to support local initiatives that celebrate the city's diversity.
claims.sourceDocument: Westminster City Council Agenda Frontsheet, 12 Nov 2025

claims.statement: The motion was moved by Councillor Adam Hug, Leader of the Council, and seconded by Councillor Ryan Jude, Cabinet Member for Climate, Ecology, Culture and Air Quality.
claims.sourceQuote: The motion, moved by Councillor Adam Hug, Leader of the Council, and seconded by Councillor Ryan Jude, Cabinet Member - Climate, Ecology, Culture and Air Quality, acknowledged the rise in far-right activity, anti-migrant language, and hate incidents across the country.

claims.statement: The motion commits to delivering a new Community Equality Strategy and establishing a cross-community working group of residents, community representatives, youth voices, and faith leaders alongside police.
claims.sourceQuote: Establishing a cross-community working group comprised of residents, community representatives, youth voices, and faith leaders to develop community-led strategies... Delivering a new Community Equality Strategy focused on improving council services and promoting community cohesion.

claims.statement: Westminster is home to residents from over 180 nationalities speaking more than 150 languages.
claims.sourceQuote: The council noted that Westminster has always been a diverse and welcoming city, with residents from over 180 nationalities speaking more than 150 languages.
